title: SelfHelp mobile-preview release (signed)
description: A signed SelfHelp mobile-preview release: a ready-built Expo web export image (served under /mobile-preview with a narrow same-origin backend proxy) plus backend compatibility metadata, the advertised mobile renderer contract version, and the curated bundled-plugin set. Peer of frontend-release.schema.json. Consumed by sh-manager. Mirrors @selfhelp/shared MobilePreviewRelease.

releasedAt.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp stamped by assemble-release.mjs.

mobileRendererVersion.description: The mobile renderer contract version this image advertises (semver). Plugin compatibility.mobile ranges are gated against this by the SelfHelp Manager preflight.

reactNativeVersion.description: React Native version the preview image was built with. Plugin compatibility.reactNative ranges are gated against this by the SelfHelp Manager preflight.

expoSdkVersion.description: Expo SDK version the preview image was built with. Plugin compatibility.expoSdk ranges are gated against this by the SelfHelp Manager preflight.

bundledPlugins.description: Curated official-plugin mobile packages baked into the image (RN-on-web). The manager uses this to compute coverage (native vs. open-on-web) for a host's enabled plugins.
